description: Returns one current entry from the official OFAC, UK or EU sanctions list by list and exact id, with proof of the official file it came from. Use it after sanctions_search_entries or sanctions_list_changes gave you an id; use sanctions_search_entries to match a name and sanctions_list_changes to see why an entry was removed. Inputs: list (required: ofac-sdn, ofac-consolidated, uk or eu) and id (required, 1 to 40 letters/digits/._-, e.g. RUS0849 on uk or 36 on ofac-sdn). Output: entry with names, aliases, programmes, countries, first_seen and last_changed, and proof (official file URL, SHA-256, source date). An unknown or removed id returns the error entry_not_listed. Reads stored snapshots refreshed about every 6 hours; a monitoring feed, not a real-time clearance decision. Terms: read-only; MCP calls are never charged. Without a key, metered routes give 10 successful answers a day free (unmetered routes are unlimited); errors do not count. On the paid HTTP routes, errors and empty answers are free. An optional API key keeps its prepaid-credit policy. When the free answers run out, the error names the HTTP alternative.

id.description: The listing's id on that list, e.g. 36 or RUS0849

list.description: The list Allowed: ofac-sdn, ofac-consolidated, uk, eu; e.g. ofac-sdn.

name: sanctions_get_entry
